title: The Carved Wood Gift Guide: What to Carve for Anglers, Cabins, Faith, Weddings and the People Who Have Everything
excerpt: Twenty-five relief designs that make gifts people keep, sorted by who you are giving to, with the wood, the size and the time each one really takes. Plus the Christmas calendar that tells you when to start.
